name: mindmap-electron
description: Electron-based desktop viewer and editor for schema-7 knowledge-map projects.

scripts.dev: npm run build:electron && npm exec -- concurrently -k "npm:dev:renderer" "npm:dev:electron"
scripts.dev:electron: npm exec -- wait-on tcp:5173 && set ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=&& set "VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173"&& node_modules\.bin\electron.cmd .
scripts.typecheck: npm exec -- tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.main.json && npm exec -- tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.preload.json && npm exec -- tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.renderer.json
scripts.build:electron: npm exec -- tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && npm exec -- tsc -p tsconfig.preload.json
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm exec -- vite build && npm run build:electron
scripts.test: npm exec -- tsx --test src/renderer/model.test.ts src/test/assistantPolicy.test.ts src/test/assistantProtocol.test.ts src/test/assistantRecovery.test.ts src/test/project.test.ts
scripts.package: npm run build && npm exec -- electron-builder --win
